Mistaken for an illegal immigrant, he is forced to take refuge in a small, family-run grocery store. Enjoying the riches to rags transition, he tells nobody his true identity, and falls in love with the grocery store owner's daughter, Yvonne. But while Aaron enjoys his life of anonymity, Yvonne covets the chance to escape her poverty.

Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. No wonder police chief Yuan Kuei becomes suspicious. He thinks he is sitting on top of a narcotics ring. His two men are ordered to watch closely movement of the opera people. Little does the chief know that actually the islanders are living off the loot their ancestors made by raiding a government gold galleon some centuries ago. They buried much of the treasure and a dormant vampire under a pagoda. Two actresses and a tutor from the troupe get to the pagoda by accident, followed by the three policemen..(n)

programme.title: 野性城市: 森森不息
programme.desc: Sir David Attenborough narrates the award-winning Wild City series that explores the wild side of Singapore. Here on the fringes of the city, the jungle harbours some fascinating species, including many that have never been filmed before. The star of the show is the Raffles' banded langur, one of the least-known primates on the planet. Found only in Singapore and Malaysia, there are only a few hundred left and around 60 have made a home in Singapore's rainforests.(n)

programme.title: Building Big 第1季
programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive.

programme.title: Building Big 第1季
programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive.

programme.title: Trucking Hell 第2季
programme.desc: In this week’s episode Recovery Op Jim is called to the scene of two crashed artics on the M1. But as Jim and his team begin to pull the truck and trailer apart, they discover the crash has split the hydraulic oil tank and it’s now leaking all over the road making the job a whole lot more complicated! Recovery Op Rory attends what looks like a simple job, but some hidden vandalism leaves him scratching his head and needing to improvise. Rookie wrecker driver Warren faces a day on the hard shoulder of the motorway trying to rescue some highly unusual vehicles - a potentially occupied prison van and a group of shark fishers.

programme.title: Growing Wild 第1季
programme.desc:
Should farming be offered as curriculum in Singapore schools? 

As the creation of the metaverse gathers pace, the chasm between the digital and the natural world will only widen. What can growing wild offer?

“A lot of people actually think that you are taking care of the plants but actually, they are taking care of us.” Plant otaku.

Gather your succulents, rally your papayas, and make a date with your favourite gardening hoe. In the final episode of Growing Wild, we get dirty. 

And we are doing it together.

programme.desc:
Should farming be offered as curriculum in Singapore schools? 

As the creation of the metaverse gathers pace, the chasm between the digital and the natural world will only widen. What can growing wild offer?

“A lot of people actually think that you are taking care of the plants but actually, they are taking care of us.” Plant otaku.

And we are doing it together.

Recovery Op Rory attends what looks like a simple job, but some hidden vandalism leaves him scratching his head and needing to improvise. programme.desc: A huge special ship on six legs, wind turbines almost 150 metres high, far out in the North Sea, off the coast of the island of Sylt. In operation, the most modern and largest installation ship in the world.(n)

programme.desc: When it appears that half of the cookies Tess and Addison baked for a charity event go missing, the girls are mystified. Could somebody have eaten an entire table of cookies? With a trail of crumbs as a clue, they chase the cookie crunching culprit.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -紙箱
programme.desc: Hmm all these boxes? What can we do? let's just say we have some 'speedy'' ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -石頭
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko have some solid ideas about what we can make with rocks.

programme.title: 優可 -放牧人
programme.desc: Yoko works his magic, and the kids suddenly find themselves herding animals in the desert. They soon start arguing, but a Cherokee chief teaches them some valuable lessons about friendship and understanding.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -不正經法律
programme.desc: Pessi decided to put their cloud up for sale because they don't deserve its good view. The silly laws forbid them from being happy. But Pessi wrote the laws himself. Now, Sprinter and Leo must try to convince him to rewrite the laws so he and Opti can be happy again.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -在邦波家吃晚餐
programme.desc: Bumble invites Sprinter and Leo for dinner because she wants to cook them delicious dishes from Earth. Leo is looking forward to eating food she knows from back home. But Bumble has never tasted food from Earth. How will she know how to make it.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -地下水
programme.desc: The birthday surprise traps Kit and Mr. Battery in a cave.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -噴泉
programme.desc: The well in the woods needs cleaning and protection from an unknown vandal.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -貿易路線
programme.desc: Howler and Little Lewis take us on an excursion down the medieval trade routes. The journey is anything but a walk in the park for these two wine merchants! In the Middle Ages, being a salesman takes a lot of guts.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -波札那之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are frustrated looking for straws, and Alim responds only with clicking sounds. Alim then takes them to Botswana to meet Ketelelo, who shows them the San language, which uses clicking sounds, and how to handle a black mamba snake.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -希臘之旅
programme.desc: Zoe finds Milo sobbing, but he insists it's just dust-boys don't cry! Alim sighs and takes them to Greece's Mytilene, where they meet Nicolai. There, they learn that men and women freely express their emotions, crying with joy or sadness.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印尼之旅
programme.desc: Zoe makes a gift for her friend Noa, puzzling Milo-she's given Noa gifts before! Zoe says she has many friends named Noa. Alim suggests it's because they're the eldest. To show how names relate to birth order, he takes them to Bali, where many people are named Wayan.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅
programme.desc: Alim finds Zoe and Milo in a messy pancake-making scene. They laugh when asked if school teaches cleaning. Alim takes them to Japan, where Akiko shows that students not only study but also take turns cleaning and helping in the canteen.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -壓力之下
programme.desc: Sunday is beach day for the entire family! Except that Mily is so stressed by her upcoming geometry exam that she doesn't want to go! She can't study and has nightmares. Will Papa Tim, Mama Sophia, Luke, and Lola be able to help her relax.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -信任的問題
programme.desc: During an outing in the park, the kids must let themselves fall backwards and be caught by Gaspard. When Mily's turn comes, she freezes. Miss Question will have to understand what ''trusting someone'' really means.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -幫手
programme.desc: Rosa's gotten a new cupboard and needs help carrying it inside. Sprinter and Riwahl offer their help. But soon their eagerness to help turns into a competition of who is the better helper.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -遵守規則
programme.desc: When Bumble notices that Leo doesn't have a flying license, she quickly puts it on herself to make sure that she gets one, so she can fly legally on Bhilka. But it's no walk in the park because there are many odd rules on Bhilka.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -植物吃喝什麼
programme.desc: How can we prove plants and flowers drink water? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of botany. Have hands-on fun by making a rainbow-coloured flower, and get to know J.C. Bose, an amazing polymath who pioneered studies into the nature of plants.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -彈跳且彎曲的光
programme.desc: What is the difference between reflection and refraction? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light. Have hands-on fun by mixing oil and water, and get to know Zhang Heng, a great polymath, who figured out the Moon reflects light like a mirror.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -尾巴對決比賽
programme.desc: Boss, Blister and Scab are always ready to play pranks on the Buffycats, but Lampo has had enough, so he decides to challenge them to a Tailoff match to solve the situation. This is going to be an exciting match.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波和海豚
programme.desc: Dolphins come to play and Ebb and Bird join in. But the dolphins get caught in the reeds as the tide goes out. Flo and Ma arrive in the dinghy to help and the dolphins escort them back downriver to the sea. Things Couldn't be Wetter.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -在布蘭特福德很久很久以前
programme.desc: The kids team up with an old enemy to pull off an epic heist on the Historical Society. Tensions run high when someone is a no-show, making the group leave their comfort zone. Joy has to distract Miss Dumont while Raign battles with a rotary phone.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -花卉末日
programme.desc: Thumbelina arrives at the campus Flower Festival with her mother, who controls all magical flowers in Fairy Tale Land. Vicky grows the evil Rebel Roses, causing chaos. LingLing is caught in the ruckus, and only Travis can save her.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -遊吟詩人和吟遊歌手
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, listening to music for entertainment is a much-appreciated pastime. Singers and musicians of that era travel round Europe singing their poetry. Famous minstrel Howler is a huge hit at a fiery banquet in his lordship's court.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -騎士們
programme.desc: Little Lewis follows every step in order to achieve his dream. After completing a plethora of thankless tasks at a young age, he moves on to the rank of ‘squire.' A chance to demonstrate his bravery on the battlefield, in order to be knighted, at last.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -奧托翻煎餅
programme.desc: Determined to win a shiny trophy of his own, Oto decides to attempt a world record for the biggest pancake. But can he really make it all by himself? The team sets off to a pancake festival at a Sugarbush in Quebec, Canada, to find out.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -中美洲蹴球
programme.desc: In antiquity, ballgame, the ancestor of basketball, was the favourite sport of Mesoamerican civilisations. There was nothing like this game to entertain the crowd and honour the gods. But cheats like Roach better beware... because the wrath of the gods is no joke.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -羅馬競技場
programme.desc: The Colosseum, the largest building in Roman antiquity, was the Romans' favourite playground. Ideal for gladiatorial fights or naval battle re-enactments... When it comes to fun, Emperor Roach knows exactly what he wants.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -佐治的一天
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, is hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -巴拿馬
programme.desc: Panama City adventure: Explored the iconic Panama Canal, rainforest boat ride, aerial tram above treetops, learned the traditional cumbia dance, and explored the cultural gems of Casco Viejo with local teens. A week of diverse experiences in Central America.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -夏威夷
programme.desc: Hawaii island-hopping: Lava exploration on the Big Island by land and sea with local teens, muddy ATV ride in Kauai, and cultural insights at a lively luau. A week of thrilling adventures and Hawaiian traditions.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -惡魔海之謎
programme.desc: Are aliens stealing things from a Japanese island and dragging them underwater? The Nektons investigate and find something dangerous.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -白努利和同伴
programme.desc: Eric learns how the Bernoulli Principle and playing with the flow of air can help him inflate a plastic bag. This same principle explains how airplanes fly, too.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -潔西的一天
programme.desc: What does the world look like through Jessi's eyes? Bright and joyful! But today, her friends are struggling, and her sunny attitude isn't helping. Determined to prove there's good in everything, Jessi sets out to fix their problems-and show us her world of optimism.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -摩托失蹤了
programme.desc: Flippy arrives at Motor's house-only to find him missing and his wheelchair locked inside. With Robbie's help, they launch a search. After Robbie claims men are smarter, it's boys vs. girls in a race to solve the mystery. But with Motor, anything could've happened.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -香料熱潮
programme.desc: Spices are a hot item in the Middle Ages! Lord Roach just can't get enough of the stuff! If you can't find the spice you want at the local market stall, it's probably on the other side of the world! And so off goes Little Lewis.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -藏寶地點X
programme.desc: When a message in a bottle washes up on shore, Darwin and Newts must use their knot knowledge to follow the trail to some pirate treasure.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -科技串連每個人
programme.desc: When rain prevents Darwin and Newts from holding a ‘show and tell' day, they use the Internet to connect with their forest whanau remotely.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -眼睛與脂肪的秘辛
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand look right into the eye. They discover what body fat does and look at it under the microscope. In the emergency room, there is a patient with a bad rash, and another with a nasty fingernail infection.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -神祕的白色珊瑚
programme.desc: The lab of Australian scientists inspecting the cause of the devastating coral reef bleaching epidemic has suffered a series of late-night robberies. And this is seriously interfering with their research.

programme.title: 天氣小英雄 -儒艮求救
programme.desc: A biologist has reported that many of Thailand's highly endangered dugongs are sick and haven't eaten for days. The fear is that something has tainted their natural food supply! The MeteoHeroes are going on a mission to save the poor dugongs.

programme.desc: Mihaela Brinzoiu is a formidable strongwoman who holds the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS title for the most frying pans rolled in one minute, achieving ten successfully rolled-up pans. She meets Alan Pixsley and shares her story of becoming a strongwoman.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 外太空 -登陸火星
programme.desc: NASA has been remarkably successful at sending robots to Mars' surface. Host Emily Calandrelli looks at the varied and ingenious methods used to land spacecraft on the red planet, starting with Pathfinder in 1997.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -眼睛與脂肪的秘辛
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand look right into the eye. They discover what body fat does and look at it under the microscope. In the emergency room, there is a patient with a bad rash, and another with a nasty fingernail infection.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -願原力與你同在
programme.desc: Eric learns about tiny electrons and how they are connected to creating static electricity. Then he rubs his head with a balloon to create his own static electricity, and uses this to move an object without touching it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 體操新星 -該談談了
programme.desc: Acro gymnast George has had enough of people misunderstanding his sport, and he is giving his classmates a presentation to let them know what it's like to be a world-class acrobatic gymnast. And Corey returns home from the World Championships in Russia.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -金牌女孩與太空人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Kelly Holmes reflects on how she became a double Olympic gold medallist and Tim Peake shares his journey from test pilot to the UK's first European Space Agency astronaut to stay on the International Space Station.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級降落傘
programme.desc: Eric makes a parachute that will slow down a falling egg just enough so it doesn't get smashed when it hits the ground. But first he experiments to figure out the best parachute size. He discovers that NASA also use parachutes to drop robotic probes on to the moon.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重大的決定
programme.desc: Ice dancer Adriano has finally chosen his new dance partner, so it's time to tell Chloe and Ella who he's picked. And speed skater Maddie loves going fast, but a mysterious illness has affected her training. She has a new plan which she hopes will help her recover.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -密碼
programme.desc: Eric learns that computer coding means writing programmes that tell robots and computers how to do certain jobs. Just as we use language to communicate with other people, there are lots of different programming or 'coding' languages to talk to computers.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -挑戰
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are halfway through their time at Vet School. And the animal care challenges keep coming. Will and Saira are facing a massive challenge as they try to figure out what is wrong with Caspar, the Boxer dog.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -俘虜
programme.desc: Captain Hammerhead has captured the Nektons aboard his submarine. Now he wants to take over the Aronnax too.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -排氣的力量
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand get scientific with farts and they launch the Ouch- Mobile - a drop-in medical clinic. Dr. Chris trains as a nurse on a ward full of robotic patients and in the emergency room, one patient has a cut nose and another has burnt their hand.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -自畫像
programme.desc: This episode shows how an artist can determine the accurate placement of eyes, ears, nose, chin, and lips on portraits by using proportions. We show you how you can do the same by just using a string and applying some rules about the human body.

programme.title: 體操新星 -出人意料
programme.desc: Acrobatic pair Finn and Kirsten are used to winning medals - they even took home the bronze for Great Britain at the World Acrobatic Championships. But now they will compete as seniors for the first time at the British Championships in Liverpool.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -來抓我
programme.desc: Today, the Junior Vets meet some feisty meerkats who need their claws trimmed, but first, they've got to catch them. Ashanti, the elephant, gets his feet and tail cleaned. Johnny and Inel discover what you get when you cross a lion and a tiger.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -巴哈馬群島
programme.desc: In this episode we join a professional free diver and take a look at the world's deepest saltwater blue hole. After that, we head over to the mangroves to see how local researchers have been tracking baby lemon sharks for decades.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -彩繪白努利
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an airbrush out of straws. Thanks to the Bernoulli principle, he uses it to create his own work of art.

programme.title: 神秘大探索系列: 絕讚星球 -掠食者迷思
programme.desc: In this episode we join the shark research team at the University of Miami to study sharks. We then head to Florida where Philippe visits an antivenom lab home to hundreds of venomous snakes.
programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -三、二、一...升空
programme.desc: The chemical reaction that takes place in the engines of a real rocket produces a large amount of very hot gas that makes the rocket lift off into the sky. Eric mixes baking powder and water to create a chemical reaction strong enough to launch a toy rocket.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -超級形狀
programme.desc: Eric learns why the triangle is such an important shape for building. He builds a bridge made of straws that is so strong that he can balance several books on it.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -驚人的神經元
programme.desc: Eric learns that neurons are the brain's tiny building blocks. He does an experiment to show what they are and how they work. He is surprised to learn that giraffes have neurons that are five metres long.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -滑冰超能力
programme.desc: Alexia and Kloe are off to London to meet Dr. Xand and the Operation Ouch team to see if a scientist can figure out why they don't get dizzy when they spin. Izzy has a very important speed trial to see if she has what it takes to join the Olympic squad.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -宴會日
programme.desc: It's the day of the gala. As the crowds arrive, there's drama backstage. Will Ella fix her costume in time for her big debut with Adriano? Will Kloe keep her nerves under control and nail her Hungarian performance? A surprising performance leaves everyone speechless.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -前陸盆地編年史
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers discover rock art and incredible biodiversity at Table Mountain National Park in South Africa. Along the way they travel on horseback to visit the Kakapo shipwreck.

programme.title: 大地探險隊: 一起來場野性之旅 -衝浪蝸牛
programme.desc: A group of young adventurers return to Table Mountain National Park in South Africa to discover the strange ways animals have adapted to survive in their secret worlds. Along the way they meet bats, surfing snails, and an army of ants protecting unusual plants.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -國王企鵝
programme.desc: Annabelle, the king penguin, is displaying some worrying symptoms. She's waving her head about skywards and Jorge is concerned she may have some neurological problems. Will Annabelle rejoin her friends on the great, icy mound at Loro Parque ever again.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -波札那之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are frustrated looking for straws, and Alim responds only with clicking sounds. Alim then takes them to Botswana to meet Ketelelo, who shows them the San language, which uses clicking sounds, and how to handle a black mamba snake.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -希臘之旅
programme.desc: Zoe finds Milo sobbing, but he insists it's just dust-boys don't cry! Alim sighs and takes them to Greece's Mytilene, where they meet Nicolai. There, they learn that men and women freely express their emotions, crying with joy or sadness.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印尼之旅
programme.desc: Zoe makes a gift for her friend Noa, puzzling Milo-she's given Noa gifts before! Zoe says she has many friends named Noa. Alim suggests it's because they're the eldest. To show how names relate to birth order, he takes them to Bali, where many people are named Wayan.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅
programme.desc: Alim finds Zoe and Milo in a messy pancake-making scene. They laugh when asked if school teaches cleaning. Alim takes them to Japan, where Akiko shows that students not only study but also take turns cleaning and helping in the canteen.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -倒數
programme.desc: Everyone's hooked on a new game dodging falling fruit-except Carol. But when she tries it, she's amazing! She climbs the leaderboard and wins a strange watch. Cool... until giant fruit starts falling on her in real life. This is no ordinary prize-it's game on.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -折射上的反射
programme.desc: Eric does a fun experiment to show how refraction plays tricks with our eyes. He learns that when we look at objects, we see the light reflected from them. Because light doesn't travel as well through water as it does through air, things in water look different to us.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -藏寶地點X
programme.desc: When a message in a bottle washes up on shore, Darwin and Newts must use their knot knowledge to follow the trail to some pirate treasure.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -科技串連每個人
programme.desc: When rain prevents Darwin and Newts from holding a ‘show and tell' day, they use the Internet to connect with their forest whanau remotely.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -植物吃喝什麼
programme.desc: How can we prove plants and flowers drink water? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of botany. Have hands-on fun by making a rainbow-coloured flower, and get to know J.C. Bose, an amazing polymath who pioneered studies into the nature of plants.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -彈跳且彎曲的光
programme.desc: What is the difference between reflection and refraction? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light. Have hands-on fun by mixing oil and water, and get to know Zhang Heng, a great polymath, who figured out the Moon reflects light like a mirror.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -藍色之謎
programme.desc: When the honey in the community garden's beehive turns bright indigo, Addison is on the case to find out what's giving the bees the blues.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -餅乾失竊案
programme.desc: When it appears that half of the cookies Tess and Addison baked for a charity event go missing, the girls are mystified. Could somebody have eaten an entire table of cookies? With a trail of crumbs as a clue, they chase the cookie crunching culprit.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -達文西奧托
programme.desc: Oto is trying to build a working model of a tank, from designs by Leonardo Da Vinci. But the tank won't roll! He followed the plans exactly, so why won't Oto's tank work? Anabella suggests they ask a friend of hers for help, so they visit Florence, Italy.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -抓鬼記
programme.desc: When Mundi is startled by Fico's prank, she insists she isn't afraid of ghosts. They don't even exist! Oto and Anabella definitely believe in ghosts. Mundi vows to prove they don't, with a trip to a so-called ‘ghost town' in Tombstone, Arizona, USA.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -紙箱
programme.desc: Hmm all these boxes? What can we do? let's just say we have some 'speedy'' ideas.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -石頭
programme.desc: Hepi and Briko have some solid ideas about what we can make with rocks.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -拉法的一天
programme.desc: Meet the Loro Parque Foundation Scientific Director - Rafa, also known as the ‘Birdman of Loro Parque'. He wears the badge with pride and every day he surrounds himself with all things ornithological - from parrots and puffins to penguins.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -大猩猩醫腳
programme.desc: Ubongo, the gorilla, has a massive cut on his foot. But how do you treat a 400-pound gorilla with a sore foot? And have you ever seen a sloth take a shower? Hugo, the sloth, will draw back the shower curtain and reveal all.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, animals are considered responsible for their actions and must answer to their crimes in a court of law! A crazy trial takes place, with Howler as the animals' attorney and Roach as the judge and persecutor.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -食物
programme.desc: Unlike life in our modern society, in the Middle Ages, people don't eat their fill every day. We follow our foodie Howler as he scavenges around for anything that takes his fancy, overstepping his mark as a mere peasant.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -領主與農民
programme.desc: Our humble peasant friend Howler can't wait for his next batch of pretzels! However, in the Middle Ages, the feudal system is ruthless, the lord always helping himself to a share of the peasant's yield. And, quite often, all that's left is a few meager crumbs.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -前所未見的雪人
programme.desc: The annual winter carnival seems to be in trouble when Addison and Alex's yeti sculpture appears to have been vandalized... perhaps by an actual angry yeti.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -祕密代號之謎
programme.desc: When strange symbols begin turning up in Ayrton Park, Alex begins thinking that an alien invasion is imminent. Addison is sceptical but there are disturbing signs that the symbols might be invaders communicating with each other.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -毛巾
programme.desc: Why throw the old towels away? Upcycling and reusing are Hepi and Briko's favourite thing to do.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -繩子
programme.desc: Summertime is here! Hepi and Briko have the perfect plan to re use all this rope we have lying around.

programme.title: 優可 -徹夜未眠
programme.desc: The kids go to the park with their parents to look at the moon using Vik's telescope, and Ranger Loops tells them about a genie named Loa, who lives on the moon, and anyone she catches falls asleep immediately.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -一名超級英雄對抗三個超級反派
programme.desc: The superhero Sprinter Galore gets trapped by two supervillains - Cleopatra and DiktaThor. It looks bleak to Sprinter, but maybe he can take escape midst their confusion of who caught him first.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -隱形竊盜案
programme.desc: Cleopatra uses invisibility paint to catch the superhero Sprinter, but she forgets that he can still use his superpower even if his head is invisible.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -魚塘
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery help the fish that is suffocating in the dirty pond.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -水壩
programme.desc: Kit must shut down the hydroelectric plant to save Mr. Battery before he is chopped in the dam's turbine.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -墨西哥之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are invited to a costume party. Alim picks Princess for Milo, but Milo refuses, saying it's a girl's costume. Alim takes them to Mexico to meet Felina. At the muxhes' party, they learn about Zapotec culture, where muxhes are neither boys nor girls.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -中國之旅
programme.desc: Milo suspects Alim ate his biscuits, but Alim won't answer yes or no. To prove his point, he takes Zoe and Milo to China, where Mei shows them that Chinese doesn't have words for 'yes' or 'no.' They discover this while helping her find her lost panda.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -芬蘭之旅
programme.desc: While it's freezing outside, Zoe and Milo are warm inside. Alim arrives with a towel, ready for a bath in the icy puddle! Zoe and Milo are amazed! Alim takes them to Finland, where Aki shows them saunas and ice baths, proving Alim's point about the refreshing ice bath.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -辛巴威之旅
programme.desc: While racing, Milo accidentally breaks his father's guitar and fears a scolding. Alim reassures him, saying not all parents scold. They go to Zimbabwe, where Bakala shows them that instead of scolding, her parents remind her of her achievements.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -腦力激盪
programme.desc: This morning in class, Leo acts like a clown rather than answering the teacher's question. The entire class is laughing, but they are also wondering why Leo can't learn. Is Leo hiding something and how can he be helped.

programme.title: 米麗的十萬個為什麼 -友誼
programme.desc: Unlike the rest of the class, Mily is having trouble finishing her origami. She wonders why Juliette, her best friend, doesn't seem to care, whereas Kun, whom she met recently, stays by her side. Mily then wonders what a real friend is supposed to be.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -清潔者3000
programme.desc: Senior declares that it's gotten too messy on Bhilka and puts all the inhabitants to work at a joint cleaning day. Sprinter gets the bright idea to invent a cleaning robot to do the work. But when it starts vacuuming up the citizens, he has to find a solution.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -偵探出動
programme.desc: The Triplets ask Sprinter and Leo to help them to solve a mystery. There's a pair of really disgusting briefs at their house, and nobody wants to say it's theirs. But can Sprinter and Leo solve the mystery of who the owner of the nasty briefs is.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -無線通訊
programme.desc: How come we can't hear people talking next to us when we're in the sea? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of sound. Have hands-on fun by making a basic phone, and get to know Guglielmo Marconi, a physicist and inventor – ‘the father of radio'.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -測繪和水平
programme.desc: How come we see the Earth as flat when we know it's round? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of geography. Have hands-on fun by making a carpenter's level, and get to know Kim Jeong-ho, a cartographer who created the first detailed map of Korea.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -皮露對恐龍
programme.desc: The Buffycats find a plastic dinosaur in the garden. Pilou wants to play with it, so they go to the park. But the dinosaur starts playing all sorts of pranks on them, and the inventor cat Edison tells them it's not just a simple toy..

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -刮風的日子
programme.desc: Ebb is not happy. It's a blowy day, good for Granny's washing. She helps Flo make a kite. The kite escapes and Bird finds it. They chase Granny's flying washing and lose an oar. Towed home by Flo's kite, Ebb cheers up. Ebb's Blowy day is nearly over.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -撞牆
programme.desc: An 'obstacle course day' in gym class forces the group to reunite and work together. Meanwhile, Kelly has been missing from school, and the gang needs to find her to continue on their mission.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -家長日
programme.desc: On 'Bring Your Parents To School Day,' Travis, Hawk, Joy, and Astoria can't enlist their parents. Rose tries to convince her mom to return to Regal Academy, but catches the attention of Melvin, Merlin's troublemaking grandson, who challenges her to a magic duel.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -傻人節
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, life may be tough, but having fun is also on the agenda! Folly Festival is a carnival where everyone sings and dances, but also has fun trading places. Howler becomes a princess for the day, and Little Lewis a lord.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -中世紀的衛生習慣
programme.desc: Howler isn't exactly a paragon of cleanliness! But seeing as he's got a soft spot for Dove, he needs to step up the hygiene if he wants to win her heart! So he introduces us to various medieval hygiene techniques.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -多奇與蝙蝠
programme.desc: Fico wants Anabella to help him create a comic book about a bat superhero! But Anabella needs to see a real bat to draw one. Doki is nervous to go on this expedition. He's heard that bats drink your blood and tangle in your hair. Why shouldn't he be afraid of bats.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -書寫的形式
programme.desc: With the invention of cuneiform writing, the Sumerians also invented the first schools. Scribal schools where students learnt to read, write and count. But with Howler on the school bench, discipline leaves something to be desired.

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -神聖的巧力
programme.desc: The Maya were crazy about chocolate. Unfortunately, not everyone could enjoy it. Rare and precious, cocoa was reserved for the powerful. But when you're a food lover like Howler, you'll do anything to enjoy your favourite drink.

programme.title: 動物大使館 -小丑魚與白虎
programme.desc: We follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more clownfish to come. In the meantime, Lin Mao, the white tiger, has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -泰國
programme.desc: Phuket, Thailand adventure: Elephant trek with local teens, boat journey to Phi Phi islands, daring taste of fried insects, and beachside Muay Thai boxing lesson. A week of cultural immersion and thrilling experiences in Southeast Asia.

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -庫拉索
programme.desc: Nicole joins local teens Skyler and Diego in Curacao for a thrilling adventure: submarine dive, flyboarding, paddleboarding, and golf.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -魚塘
programme.desc: Kit and Mr. Battery help the fish that is suffocating in the dirty pond.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -水壩
programme.desc: Kit must shut down the hydroelectric plant to save Mr. Battery before he is chopped in the dam's turbine.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -比武大賽
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, tournaments are all the rage! When Howler's behavior is interpreted of that as a crazed fan, he unwittingly finds himself in the shoes of a knight, embarking on a wild joust.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -寂寞的吉姆
programme.desc: The rarest tortoise in the world has been stolen and the Nektons are searching for it. But they're walking into a trap.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -彩繪白努利
programme.desc: Eric learns how to make an airbrush out of straws. Thanks to the Bernoulli principle, he uses it to create his own work of art.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -腦袋大亂
programme.desc: Something's wrong-Motor is meowing! Carol and Robbie find he's swapped brains with a cat in a lab experiment gone right... but now he can't switch back! As they try to fix it, chaos erupts: Robbie ends up in Carol's body, Carol in Robbie's, and Motor's still a cat.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -危險!艾伯特失控了
programme.desc: Albert must tutor Robbie-or lose his right to take exams. But Robbie won't listen and just plays video games. So Albert fights fire with fire, becoming the new class terror. As Albert turns into a mini-Robbie, things spiral-and now Robbie's the one who's worried.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -弄臣
programme.desc: Lord Roach is feeling really down! His wife Geraldine goes out of her way to entertain him, bringing in acrobats, musicians, etc. But it's no good. Enter Little Lewis, dressed in his court jester costume and Lord Roach is very happy.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -奇異果山谷救援小隊
programme.desc: When one of their friends gets hurt, Darwin and Newts form the Kiwifruit Valley Rescue Team to help in an emergency.

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -黑妮的雞舍
programme.desc: When Heni's new chickens take over her garden, Darwin and Newts come up with a plan to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -大腦房與吞入型內視鏡
programme.desc: Dr. Chris uses a tiny camera to show what happens when we swallow. Dr. Xand goes into a special chamber that removes data from his brain. At the hospital, one patient has a broken ankle and another has split her earlobe.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -極佳的溶解度
programme.desc: Eric is not sure what soluble means. To find out, he makes a snow globe and compares things that are soluble in water with things that are not.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -奶油妙招
programme.desc: Eric uses marbles to make butter out of cream. He learns how butter used to be made and how it is made today.

programme.desc: The youngsters visit a blowhole and scale some difficult cliffs to understand how it works. They find new plants and animals and when night falls, they come across some interesting spiders, amphibians and reptiles.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -巨大烏賊
programme.desc: Ant and Fontaine hunt for the rarest of ocean creatures, the colossal squid. But what happens when it turns out to be smarter than you.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -怪獸獵人
programme.desc: Media superstar 'Devil Daniels - Monster Hunter' is hunting a sea-creature he believes is a menace, but the Nektons want to protect.

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -食人魚

programme.title: 和格林韋德一家環保生活 -重複使用塑膠瓶
programme.desc: With so many plastic bottles in the kitchen, the Grimwades decide to go green and do something about it.

programme.title: 奇妙手作時間實驗室 -紙飛機起飛臺
programme.desc: Take flight with this marvellous make that is just plane fun.

programme.title: 優可 -機器人

programme.desc: How do you breathe in and out? In this make we'll build a respiratory system. It sounds complicated, but it won't take lung.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -越南之旅
programme.desc: Zoe has made some delicious cupcakes and invites Milo and Alim to try them out. Zoe is surprised to see the hamster eating on the floor instead of on the table. Well, in Vietnam, eating on the floor is not something unusual.

programme.title: 小小致富夢想家 -員工旅遊
programme.desc: Looking for some inspiration, the team organises a much-needed corporate retreat. When Max's dad, Bryan, gets lost in the woods, the gang comes together to find him. And Helen's plans to spend the weekend relaxing at home have been ruined.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -眼睛與脂肪的秘辛
programme.desc: Dr. Chris and Dr. Xand look right into the eye. They discover what body fat does and look at it under the microscope. In the emergency room, there is a patient with a bad rash, and another with a nasty fingernail infection.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -絕妙的五感體驗
programme.desc: Eric is blindfolded and has to figure out what a mystery object is using his other four senses – hearing, taste, touch and smell. He learns that although most animals have the same senses people do, they use them differently.

programme.title: 人體奧奇實驗室 -大腦房與吞入型內視鏡
programme.desc: Dr. Chris uses a tiny camera to show what happens when we swallow. Dr. Xand goes into a special chamber that removes data from his brain. At the hospital, one patient has a broken ankle and another has split her earlobe.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -極佳的溶解度
programme.desc: Eric is not sure what soluble means. To find out, he makes a snow globe and compares things that are soluble in water with things that are not.

programme.title: 小小獸醫 -露比的臭腳
programme.desc: The Junior Vets are on the farm, hoping to discover some pregnant cows. Poor Fern, the lurcher, has been abandoned and needs a new home. Ruby, the lamb, has a smelly infected foot, and Johnny and Inel meet a dog who likes to join the family for dinner.

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -金牌女孩與太空人

programme.title: 貝爾吉羅斯呈現成就不凡之路 -消防員與仿生人
programme.desc: In this episode of Bear Grylls' Becoming Xtraordinary, Sabrina Cohen-Hatton, the most senior ranking firefighter in the UK, and Mark Ormrod, triple amputee and four-time Invictus Games gold medallist, share their incredible stories of resilience.

programme.title: 冰上新星 -重新上路
programme.desc: The Icicles are taking a huge risk and have choreographed a very ambitious routine. Charlie and Freddie are off to a competition in Guildford via Grandma's house for a sleepover. And a talented young skater from Russia has got everyone in a spin.

programme.title: 科學爆好玩 -風箏把戲

programme.desc: Xavier battles to keep up with the baby barn owl's voracious appetite. Laura answers a cry for help about a dog called Bear that looks like a horse and plays like a tiger.

programme.title: 魔法數學 -離開網格
programme.desc: By using gridlines, an object can be scaled up (magnified) or scaled down (shrunk). In this episode mathemagician Eric shows how to draw a picture of yourself that's completely to scale - even if the original is teeny tiny.

programme.category: Documentary, Nature, Environment, Travel, Adventure, Animals

programme.desc: Darwin and Newts build a wind speed-and-direction measuring device to warn when the rain is coming.

programme.desc: Host Alie Ward presents a jet ski submarine that flies underwater, a soccer ball that creates electricity, an insect catcher and the new generation of vinyl records.

programme.desc: The team visits the Gamkaberg Mountains in search of a magnificent creature that escaped extinction in the inaccessible canyons of this fortress. While lost in a cave, they miraculously stumble on the almost-vanished Cape Mountain Zebra.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -幽靈潛水艇
programme.desc: Does a ghost submarine sail out there somewhere in the ocean? Ant believes it does.

programme.title: 深海大探險 -深淵在凝視你

programme.desc: How can microbes be of use at a birthday party? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of microorganisms. Have hands-on fun by experimenting with yeast, and get to know Satoshi Omura, a biochemist, who discovered medicine inside miniscule microbes.(n)

programme.title: 科學量販店 -環境科學
programme.desc: How do sea animals stay warm in extreme cold? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of environmental science. Have hands-on fun by creating a blubber glove, and get to know Rachel Carson, a marine biologist and chief advocate of global environmentalism.(n)

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -冰淇淋的渴望
programme.desc: It's an extremely hot day and Cream, the ice cream maker cat, has bad news: his ice cream machine isn't working! The Buffycats help Cream prepare ice cream manually, but Baby Pie sneaks in the lab and eats it all! How will they save the day.(n)

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的新朋友
programme.desc: Ebb and Flo are inseparable best friends but Bird arrives and gets in the way. Ebb is upset. Until learning to share is understood. Now Ebb, Bird and Flo are the best of friends. Things couldn't be better.(n)

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -催化劑
programme.desc: Raign, Joy, and Hulk get thrown in detention and discover a trap door leading to mysterious tunnels. They must work with the school bully - Brett - to solve the riddle before their time is up.(n)

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -巨龍決鬥賽
programme.desc: Rose, Hawk, and the others have a new Dragon Riding Teacher, Sir George, who favors Vicky and dislikes Coach Beast. They settle on a huge dragon tournament at Castle Beast. In the final obstacle course, it's Rose vs. Vicky, but Vicky isn't playing fair.(n)

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年
programme.desc: Children of noble stock receive an education in a castle environment while peasant offspring spend their youth working in the fields or at home. Daily life is busy, from a very young age. But kids never forget to have fun and goof around or playing pranks on each other.(n)

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -宴會
programme.desc: Howler and Dove are invited to Lord Roach's banquet. But banquets come with all kinds of rules and regulations, exposing the greedier guests in the room! Hardened foodies, they indulge in all kinds of scheming.(n)

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -火星探險
programme.desc: Can we really go to Mars? The team blasts off, and before you know it, they're exploring Mars while Fico and Oto go looking for the lander. But the two are stunned to see a space-suited Martian take the lander inside his house.(n)

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -茅廁時光
programme.desc: The Colosseum and the public baths weren't Rome's only claims to fame! Toilets, also known as latrines, never failed to amaze those who visited them, for a whole host of surprising reasons that it would be impolite to go into here..(n)

programme.title: 怪奇大歷史 -努比亞弓箭手
programme.desc: In Nubia, the bow was a real passion! Precision shots, rain of arrows... For the Nubians, bow handling held no secrets. And children, even the clumsiest ones, dreamt of imitating great archers like Howler! At their own risk.(n)

programme.title: 動物大使館 -烏龜菲德莉卡
programme.desc: Federica, the turtle, has arrived from Italy after a run-in with a container ship. Loro Parque has offered to be her ‘forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? Esmeralda, the iguana, has a lumpy belly and Jorge, the vet, is worried.(n)

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -克羅埃西亞
programme.desc: Croatia adventure: Plitvice National Park and Bisevo exploration, European Eagle Owl encounter with local teens, rock climbing at Paklenica National Park, and a taste of Croatian folk music. A week of diverse escapades with Nicole in the incredible country of Croatia.(n)

programme.title: 華麗的冒險 -魁北克
programme.desc: Quebec winter thrill: Dogsledding, ice sculpting, hockey lesson with local teens, and extreme sledding at Village Vacances Valcartier. A week of icy adventures with Nicole in Canada.(n)

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -童年

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -海溝

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -司法與正義
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, safety's a little shaky. So is justice! It's ‘Sheriff' Howler's job to hunt down outlaws and bring them before the judge. But the methods he uses are a trifle different from what we're used to today.(n)

programme.title: 深海大探險 -巨大烏賊
programme.desc: Ant and Fontaine hunt for the rarest of ocean creatures, the colossal squid. But what happens when it turns out to be smarter than you.(n)

programme.desc: Eric is fooled by an optical illusion with three lines. Then he draws a goldfish and a bowl and sticks them to a pencil to create his own optical illusion.(n)

programme.title: 黏土頑童 -表兄弟

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -奇怪的審判

programme.title: 達爾文與紐茨 -金屬探測器

programme.desc: Darwin and Newts restore an eroded riverbank by using a trebuchet to transport sand.(n)

programme.title: 全港開餐100強
programme.desc: 今集開餐推介：品嘗正宗關東江戶前壽司，件件都是主廚精心傑作! 台灣古早便當、牛肉麵，鹵水拼盤，是大家都掛念的台灣美食，一次過滿足大家胃口!精緻西餐加上一絕靚景，款款菜式都賣相出色靚，是開餐的頂級享受！說起豬扒飯相信大家都非常熟悉，不同創新口味，味道獨.

programme.title: 健康關注組
programme.desc: 肌萎縮性脊髓側索硬化症，亦即是漸凍人症，這個病很罕見，估計全港大約有六百名患者，每年新症一百多宗。患者全身肌肉活動能力急速惡化，最後可能因無法呼吸而致死！其中一成的患者活不過一年，八成患者於兩至五年內去世，而今集的其中一位嘉賓，就是餘下的一成，由發病.

programme.title: 開間咖啡店
programme.desc: 三人夢想一起開一間咖啡店，於是不停走訪香港多間人氣咖啡店去取經，向專業咖啡師拜師學煮咖啡，而李綺雯、黎紀君亦親自試整甜品和輕食。今集會到中上環一間咖啡店，老闆親自沖出一杯獲獎創意咖啡，黎紀君、李綺雯會分別泡製伯爵茶戚風蛋糕和意式海鮮沙律。.

時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第四集：李臨和夢安算家庭開銷
programme.desc: 李臨說自己一直沒有告訴夢安失業的事是因為不想給她徒增煩惱，他知道夢安工作壓力已經很大了。第二天李臨沒再去假裝上班，許夢安替他找藉口，說要見客戶。女兒離開家後，李臨和夢安開始算起家庭日常開銷.

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 牛肉全身皆寶，不單口感多變，更是補充蛋白質與鐵質的好幫手。兩位識食專員特意造訪潮汕火鍋店，體驗列入「汕頭市非物質文化遺產」的潮汕牛肉火鍋，除了學習「三起三落」的涮肉秘訣及解構「吊龍」、「匙柄」等刁鑽部位的滋味奧秘之外，他們還用牛丸打球，有沒有那麼誇張？大廚 Will 亦發揮創意，炮製「韓式牛肉卷」，讓今集重量級嘉賓—港大醫學院院長劉澤星教授—大飽口福！. 節目中，劉教授逐一拆解「風濕」病患者的飲食迷思：痛風患者是否真的要與牛肉絕緣？熱愛長跑的他，更會剖析運動與關節保養的關係，又談談他如何實踐「快樂能醫百病」的養生哲學。. 主持：梁凱寧(Maggie)、Will Leung. 嘉賓：劉澤星（香港大學副校長(健康)兼李嘉誠醫學院院長／風濕及臨床免疫學講座教授.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 動聽的歌曲是百聽不厭的！《港樂．講樂》嚴選一系列值得回味的作品，讓大家再次可以欣賞歌手們的精彩表演。首先頭打陣的系列，就來一個活力爆燈的「動感快歌」。跳舞快歌講求力量與節奏感的配合，曲風、舞蹈編排都可以帶來不同的視聽享受。你的心水歌曲是否榜上有名？記得留意今集節目！. 主持. 阮頌陽.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 淨零排放新時代
programme.desc: 駕駛體驗從此不一樣。問題是，我們的方向正確嗎? 電動車變革到底是什麼？是否確實可行？我們又需要付出什麼代價？本節目將探討最新的電動車技術、發展障礙與及其中的爭議。. 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) . 播出時間： (首播) 2026年1月13日 星期二 晚上10時. . Driving will never be the same again. But are we on the right road? What are the plans to change the cars we drive? Is it possible and what will it take? In this program, we explore the latest innovations, the roadblocks, and the controversies in the car industry. . Bilingual: Cantonese / English (TV version) . Time: (First run) 2026.01.13 Tue, 10pm.

programme.sub-title: 第九十二集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十二集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. 「澔天」經常心不在焉，寶欣感奇怪。「澔天」突然發現甜 CC和wheel 仔都有一個很漂亮的錦盒，但內裡卻盛載著一些不重要的東西，「澔天」大怒，拂袖離開。眾人不明所以，唯獨花哩碌若有所思。. 【故事時間】「最好的發明」. 承接昨日的故事書環節，今集繼續有吳浩康哥哥為小朋友講故事。主角諾諾從60年前回來，難民營之旅啟發了他的思維，繼而創造了一個新的發明。究竟他的發明有什麼厲害之處？. 【故事小手工】. 今集澔天園長教大家利用凹凸透鏡，製作簡單的望遠鏡.

programme.desc: 汪父和馬魁再因當年的事爭論。汪新攔住汪父指責，汪父氣急暈倒。幸虧搶救及時，汪父脫險，但開始出現健忘症。汪父趁失憶前，向馬魁承認錯誤。當年，汪父試圖跟小偷對峙，拉住跳車的小偷，不想小偷跌死。汪父嚇壞跑掉了。這麼多年不敢說出口，是因為他才是真正的兇手.

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十三集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十三集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. 「澔天」一人在納悶，這時花哩碌在他背後出現，原來她一早發現他並不是園長澔天。「澔天」介紹自己，原來他是從 60 年後回到 Bobieland，他是園長澔天的孫子，名叫澔孫。他坐時光機回來，是因為爺爺曾經告訴他，在Bobieland藏有一個錦盒，找到它就可以找到快樂的真諦。. 【More More 魔術See】. 今集Magic Kevin 終於揭示自己真正身份，原來他是一個科學家，今天為大家帶來「量子力學超級電筒」﹐可以隨意改變物件的大小！. 【反轉科學】. 究竟光線是否只行直線，不會轉彎呢？STEM SIR 會跟大家示範幾個光學實驗，不但令光線轉彎，而且輕易製造出七色彩虹.

Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.10.23 MON 10:30pm.

programme.desc: 于海讓婉真趕緊辭職回家，別在外面瞎胡鬧。婉真卻非常鄭重的通知他離婚。露營當天，一家人玩起了真心話大冒險的遊戲，雲階問李臨是不是失業了。但雲階非但不難過，還對老爸信心滿滿.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 寒冷冬日，即使衣服穿得再厚，你是否仍淪為手腳冰冷的「人體雪條」？這未必只是單純的氣血虛，背後可能隱藏著雷諾氏現象、甲狀腺功能低下或心血管疾病的健康警號。本集節目以中西醫角度教你全方位「解凍」，並拆解坊間以薑茶或酒暖身、穿襪睡覺等等迷思是否可行。嘉賓更會分享一套實用的「暖身攻略」，尋找身體自帶的「暖氣開關」。不想在寒冬中繼續縮手縮腳，請鎖定本集精彩內容，與我們一起告別冰冷，由內而外暖透全身！. 主持：鄭萃雯、黃秉康醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生（香港中文大學醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)/家庭醫學專科醫生.(n)

programme.title: 證義搜查線之騙局拼圖 (普通話)
programme.desc: 年约65岁的冰婶早年丧夫，与儿子关系淡泊，空虚之下误投网骗情缘的怀抱，将毕生积蓄投资在一个网骗对象所推介的虚假股票交易平台之中，血本无归！证监会调查组高级经理覃家辉Tony带领新入职组员余凯茵进行调查，追查到疑似与诈骗平台组织有关的负责人，是一名身处马来西亚的港人汤志钧。证监会在当地机构协助下与汤志钧进行视像问话，但汤志钧有备而来，以身体不适、记性不好、情绪不稳等大量借口砌词回避。基于人道立场，凯茵对他无赖的做法也无可奈何，而熟练的Tony见怪不怪，以另一思路与他展开角力，最后看穿汤志钧的盘算，在步步进逼下令汤招认事实。虽然制止了下一个骗局诞生，但贪念的蔓延却令冰婶再次投入另一个更大的股市骗局之中….(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集：新刑偵技術助警方破案
programme.desc: 警隊通過心測成功破獲槍擊案，海平因此對心測產生了興趣。此時，陶副廳長和秦川正參觀李文的資訊情報中心，李文通過資料分析更快破獲了一宗命案，就此雷主任決定開班講解新舊刑偵技術的應用。2014年1月，清江市野外賭場發生爆炸案，秦川對案件偵破提出了系統分析.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 無極飛行
programme.sub-title: 無極飛行第五集：巴西 - 亞馬遜森林守護者
programme.desc: 曾為非法伐木者和非法淘金者工作的巴西機師Fernando Bezerra決定放棄一切，參與保衛亞馬遜這個「地球之肺」的戰鬥。他的任務多姿多彩，而且極為重要，包括：監察森林被砍伐的情況、保護原住民社區、緊急醫療運送，及較近期的抗擊新冠疫情之戰…… 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版) 播出時間： (首播) 2023年10月23日 星期一晚上10時30分 Formerly employed by illegal loggers or illegal gold miners, Fernando Bezerra has decided to give up everything to take part in the fight for the preservation of the lung of the planet: the Amazon. The missions of this Brazilian pilot are as varied as they are vital: monitoring deforestation, protecting indigenous communities, emergency medical evacuations and, more recently, participating in the fight against the Covid-19 pandemic. . Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2023.10.23 MON 10:30pm.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集將探索人與動物關係的演變。從古代中國及世界文明談起，我們回溯動物曾作為勞動力、祭祀神靈的媒介，甚至是賭博與馬戲團中的娛樂工具，隨著時代推移，這種功利關係逐漸轉化為情感依託。我們將剖析「寵物」概念的興起，看昔日文人雅士賞玩的花鳥蟲魚，如何演變為今日家中備受呵護的貓狗以至動物權益的誕生。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 陳家怡(嶺南大學歷史系研究助理教授).(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十三集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十三集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. 「澔天」一人在納悶，這時花哩碌在他背後出現，原來她一早發現他並不是園長澔天。「澔天」介紹自己，原來他是從 60 年後回到 Bobieland，他是園長澔天的孫子，名叫澔孫。他坐時光機回來，是因為爺爺曾經告訴他，在Bobieland藏有一個錦盒，找到它就可以找到快樂的真諦。. 【More More 魔術See】. 今集Magic Kevin 終於揭示自己真正身份，原來他是一個科學家，今天為大家帶來「量子力學超級電筒」﹐可以隨意改變物件的大小！. 【反轉科學】. 究竟光線是否只行直線，不會轉彎呢？STEM SIR 會跟大家示範幾個光學實驗，不但令光線轉彎，而且輕易製造出七色彩虹.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師想買一張彩券。彩券售價3歐元，但他只有一張10歐元的鈔票，於是他出發去找零錢……最後他來到了3000年前的馬爾代夫，那裡的人們使用貝殼作為貨幣。為了找到零錢，尋古大師只好繼續找。最終，他遇到了克羅伊斯國王，他親手鑄造金幣。之後，他去了16世紀的德國，那裡的人們用一台巨大的鑄幣機鑄造硬幣。之後，他去了21世紀的法國，來到了一家年產15億枚硬幣的工廠.(n)

programme.title: 奇趣100 FUN
programme.desc: 尋古大師的手機沒電了！毫無預警地，尋古大師匆匆赴約，途中向我們展示了現代電話的雛形：一個用繩子把兩個杯子連在一起的兒童遊戲。在 19 世紀，他目睹了一項專利被盜，以及自稱發明了電話的發明家之間的爭吵。回到 21 世紀，尋古大師縮小身形，潛入手機，在眾多應用程式中穿梭。這真是革命性的！然而，手機在全球的成功也帶來了新的問題，例如成癮和污染.(n)

programme.title: 紅粉緋緋與彼得叻叻豬
programme.desc: (A)每年的第一場雪總是讓人興奮。如果所下的雪是粉紅色的話，那就更讓人雀躍！緋緋和莉莉花了一天的時間堆起了一個粉紅色的雪仙子，並設法讓她保存下來，不會融化.(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第三十集：谷嶠正視內心情感
programme.desc: 袁歌看出來谷嶠喜歡熊啟明，熊啟明對谷嶠應該也是真心的，鼓勵谷嶠。谷嶠約了熊啟明見面，承認自己喜歡熊啟明。袁歌和杜秉文在家裡約會，接到了孫斌的電話，一起去找孫斌。袁歌告訴杜秉文，孫斌有憂鬱症。郝帥覺得這個孫斌不簡單，建議讓杜秉文帶孫斌去見心理醫生.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.sub-title: 民安隊少年團「新團員啟導課程」
programme.desc: 民眾安全服務隊（民安隊）少年團是民安隊轄下一個青少年制服團體，民安隊少年團每月都會設有新團員招募日，邀請年滿12歲但未滿16歲的青少年加入，並安排為期四天的「新團員啟導課程」，新團員透過參與多元群體活動和訓練，如沿繩下降、坍塌搜救和無人機體驗等活動，培養他們的自信心和責任感，為成為正式少年團團員作充分準備.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：馬燕向汪新提出分手
programme.desc: 胡處長找馬魁談話，馬魁來探視自首的汪父。汪永革道歉，請求馬魁原諒。為成全汪新和馬燕，汪父欲跟汪新斷絕父子關係，下跪請求馬魁同意。馬魁沉默，然後離開。汪新已知與馬燕的感情無法挽回，內心痛苦。馬燕提出分手，汪新拒絕。看著兩人，馬魁亦是非常難受.(n)

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第三十六集：汪新和馬燕舉行婚禮
programme.desc: 馬魁召集院裡的鄰居，感謝院裡人自妻子王素芳離開後對他家的照顧，重點感謝沈大夫，並且表達對沈大夫的情感。馬魁表示會娶沈大夫，沈大夫卻在寫下離別信後離開。汪新馬燕的婚禮在大院舉行，馬燕和汪新跪地給汪父和馬魁敬茶，看著眼前的一對新人，馬魁心中感慨萬千.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十四集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十四集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. Bobieland 舉行「時光錦囊」活動，眾成員都準備了一些有意義的東西放進錦盒內，Okie Bobie 把珍貴大合照放進錦盒，唯獨澔孫沒有準備。澔孫看見盒內的物品，反應極大，因為那個就是爺爺要他找的鐵盒！. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集請來機械人科技公司創辦人麥騫譽博士，為大家介紹他製造過的機械人，以及分享他的追尋機械人夢想之路.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 來認識最自主的動物寶寶，牠們在出生後不久就懂得如何行走、游泳或爬行，並會自行覓食。從剛出生就必須在沙灘上依靠導航爬向海洋的綠海龜寶寶，到看似平凡卻極其獨立、喜愛獨來獨往的家貓，我們會為你介紹地球上十大最自立、最堅韌、最令人驚嘆的動物寶寶.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 陽光明媚，海鸚們踢球玩樂，尊尼彈著吉他。玩到肚子餓時，卻發現只剩一塊蛋糕！最後尊尼提議：「用踢球比賽決定誰吃！」遊戲馬上開始.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 小特不小心從奧斯的外星方塊發出了警報信號。此時正在軌道上運行的好友托斯收到了這個訊息.(n)

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第六集：夢安為懷孕的事發愁
programme.desc: 許父理解年輕人工作的不易，他希望李臨有甚麼困難一定要跟家人講，許父告訴李臨，他一直把李臨當作兒子看。李臨十分感動。夢安正為懷孕的事發愁，張總又來施壓，這次項目涉及不少賠償.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 「一世人兩兄弟」這句話，道出了哥哥潘冠忠及弟弟潘冠昌之間，一個關於愛、責任和希望的故事。. 從小Simon就知道哥哥是一個不一樣的哥哥。因為哥哥的行動、溝通、情緒及智力各方面都和一般人不同。面對種種因病而來的「古怪」行為，Simon曾經對哥哥、對家人選擇疏遠不理，外出不願和哥哥同行，食飯選擇分枱而座，為的是避免被人知道有這個哥哥。但隨著母親年紀漸長，Simon慢慢意識到照顧哥哥早已是他不能割捨的責任，而他亦是這個家庭的唯一依靠。於是，他報讀與社工和護理相關的課程，成為一位助人自助的社工。在影樓拍攝畢業相的那天，一家人相擁的一眸間，就印証了「一世人兩兄弟」這句話的真諦。. 照顧者的苦澀及付出往往是默默無聞。到底如何面對漫長的照顧之路，如何支援照顧者，並非單是家人之間的協調，也是社會必須共同支援。所以，哥哥每週一至五會到由社會福利署資助的「扶康會」祖堯成人訓練中心，接受訓練和日間照顧，讓哥哥在那裡找到了屬於自己的小天地，同時也令家人可以得到喘息的機會.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「操肌」，曾經被視為係男士專屬的運動，追求的是肌肉及力量提升。不過近年越來越多女士、青少年，甚至殘疾人士都加入健身行列，希望改善體態，更視之為一種自信的生活方式。 全港連鎖健身中心數目在今年創歷史新高，這股風潮背後，反映了一種怎樣的生活態度？健身文化普及又對市民身心健康，以至社會經濟帶來甚麼影響.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：爆炸案偵查陷入僵局
programme.desc: 秦川認為犯罪嫌疑人可能混在賭徒中，必須從賭場情況入手。警方在案發現場附近找到家中藏有雷管、炸藥的阿金，然而經審訊後，秦川判斷他不像疑犯。秦川嘗試從現場遺留物入手，而曹陽等人則在爆炸殘原件上發現了女性DNA樣本，但這些線索皆無助破案，案件頓時陷入僵局.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 「一世人兩兄弟」這句話，道出了哥哥潘冠忠及弟弟潘冠昌之間，一個關於愛、責任和希望的故事。. 從小Simon就知道哥哥是一個不一樣的哥哥。因為哥哥的行動、溝通、情緒及智力各方面都和一般人不同。面對種種因病而來的「古怪」行為，Simon曾經對哥哥、對家人選擇疏遠不理，外出不願和哥哥同行，食飯選擇分枱而座，為的是避免被人知道有這個哥哥。但隨著母親年紀漸長，Simon慢慢意識到照顧哥哥早已是他不能割捨的責任，而他亦是這個家庭的唯一依靠。於是，他報讀與社工和護理相關的課程，成為一位助人自助的社工。在影樓拍攝畢業相的那天，一家人相擁的一眸間，就印証了「一世人兩兄弟」這句話的真諦。. 照顧者的苦澀及付出往往是默默無聞。到底如何面對漫長的照顧之路，如何支援照顧者，並非單是家人之間的協調，也是社會必須共同支援。所以，哥哥每週一至五會到由社會福利署資助的「扶康會」祖堯成人訓練中心，接受訓練和日間照顧，讓哥哥在那裡找到了屬於自己的小天地，同時也令家人可以得到喘息的機會.(n)

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港戶外生態教育協會保育總監沈鼎榮，分享有關蜂的知識。本集以切葉蜂、扁頭泥蜂和彩帶蜂作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境及AR增強實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索蜂的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 千年陝菜 (第二季)
programme.desc: 「夫禮之初，始諸飲食」。禮制之範，始於宴席。不論皇帝登基、將士出征，還是士子金榜題名，百姓娶妻生子，中國歷史的每一個重大階段，每一個關鍵環節無不伴隨着宴席.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 千年陝菜 (第二季)
programme.desc: 一座城市有一座城市獨特的面孔。三千年的古城不僅僅是一張張褪色發黃的模糊記憶，也不僅僅是一堆堆厚重冰冷的文物古跡，古城也是當下尋常人家的市井煙火，是街頭巷尾老店中平淡悠閒的溫馨笑容.(n)

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第六集：夢安為懷孕的事發愁
programme.desc: 許父理解年輕人工作的不易，他希望李臨有甚麼困難一定要跟家人講，許父告訴李臨，他一直把李臨當作兒子看。李臨十分感動。夢安正為懷孕的事發愁，張總又來施壓，這次項目涉及不少賠償.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「操肌」，曾經被視為係男士專屬的運動，追求的是肌肉及力量提升。不過近年越來越多女士、青少年，甚至殘疾人士都加入健身行列，希望改善體態，更視之為一種自信的生活方式。 全港連鎖健身中心數目在今年創歷史新高，這股風潮背後，反映了一種怎樣的生活態度？健身文化普及又對市民身心健康，以至社會經濟帶來甚麼影響.(n)

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解3
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解3》邀請了香港戶外生態教育協會保育總監沈鼎榮，分享有關蜂的知識。本集以切葉蜂、扁頭泥蜂和彩帶蜂作例子，並首次利用XR擴增實境及AR增強實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索蜂的外貌特徵、食性、生活習性.(n)

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 濰坊、威海、青島
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集：爆炸案偵查陷入僵局
programme.desc: 秦川認為犯罪嫌疑人可能混在賭徒中，必須從賭場情況入手。警方在案發現場附近找到家中藏有雷管、炸藥的阿金，然而經審訊後，秦川判斷他不像疑犯。秦川嘗試從現場遺留物入手，而曹陽等人則在爆炸殘原件上發現了女性DNA樣本，但這些線索皆無助破案，案件頓時陷入僵局.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十四集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十四集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. Bobieland 舉行「時光錦囊」活動，眾成員都準備了一些有意義的東西放進錦盒內，Okie Bobie 把珍貴大合照放進錦盒，唯獨澔孫沒有準備。澔孫看見盒內的物品，反應極大，因為那個就是爺爺要他找的鐵盒！. 【嘉賓來了】. 今集請來機械人科技公司創辦人麥騫譽博士，為大家介紹他製造過的機械人，以及分享他的追尋機械人夢想之路.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 來認識最自主的動物寶寶，牠們在出生後不久就懂得如何行走、游泳或爬行，並會自行覓食。從剛出生就必須在沙灘上依靠導航爬向海洋的綠海龜寶寶，到看似平凡卻極其獨立、喜愛獨來獨往的家貓，我們會為你介紹地球上十大最自立、最堅韌、最令人驚嘆的動物寶寶.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 陽光明媚，海鸚們踢球玩樂，尊尼彈著吉他。玩到肚子餓時，卻發現只剩一塊蛋糕！最後尊尼提議：「用踢球比賽決定誰吃！」遊戲馬上開始.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 小特不小心從奧斯的外星方塊發出了警報信號。此時正在軌道上運行的好友托斯收到了這個訊息.(n)

programme.title: 我們的當打之年
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：孫斌裝病被杜秉文發現
programme.desc: 谷嶠在飯店等著華美陳總，偶遇郝帥。兩人看到陳總扶著喝多了鄭宴熙上房。谷嶠擔心，跟著兩人。谷嶠聽到鄭宴熙喊救命，和郝帥救出鄭宴熙。事後，鄭宴熙要袁歌轉達對谷嶠的感謝。光科傳媒資金出現了問題。孫斌裝病被杜秉文發現。孫斌對袁歌說杜秉文誣陷自己還毆打自己.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 「一世人兩兄弟」這句話，道出了哥哥潘冠忠及弟弟潘冠昌之間，一個關於愛、責任和希望的故事。. 從小Simon就知道哥哥是一個不一樣的哥哥。因為哥哥的行動、溝通、情緒及智力各方面都和一般人不同。面對種種因病而來的「古怪」行為，Simon曾經對哥哥、對家人選擇疏遠不理，外出不願和哥哥同行，食飯選擇分枱而座，為的是避免被人知道有這個哥哥。但隨著母親年紀漸長，Simon慢慢意識到照顧哥哥早已是他不能割捨的責任，而他亦是這個家庭的唯一依靠。於是，他報讀與社工和護理相關的課程，成為一位助人自助的社工。在影樓拍攝畢業相的那天，一家人相擁的一眸間，就印証了「一世人兩兄弟」這句話的真諦。. 照顧者的苦澀及付出往往是默默無聞。到底如何面對漫長的照顧之路，如何支援照顧者，並非單是家人之間的協調，也是社會必須共同支援。所以，哥哥每週一至五會到由社會福利署資助的「扶康會」祖堯成人訓練中心，接受訓練和日間照顧，讓哥哥在那裡找到了屬於自己的小天地，同時也令家人可以得到喘息的機會.(n)

南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第三十七集：牛大力在火車偶遇姚玉玲
programme.desc: 為讓馬魁同意自己辭職，馬燕開始裝病。馬魁到汪新家探查狀況，揭穿馬燕的意圖。汪新用馬燕做生意成功的話說服馬魁。馬魁鬆動，同意馬燕辭職。在火車軟臥，牛大力和姚玉玲偶遇，兩人嘮嗑，各自感慨千萬。看著姚玉玲離開的背景，牛大力淚流滿面，似乎徹底跟過去告別.(n)

programme.title: 南來北往
programme.sub-title: 第三十八集：馬魁懷疑賈金龍是毒販
programme.desc: 除夕夜，馬魁跟馬健包餃子，談及沈大夫的事情。馬魁為馬燕準備了新衣服，並送上紅包。馬魁邀請汪新和汪父到家裡吃餃子過年。哈城被抓到的毒販犯了癲癇送去醫院搶救。馬魁二人留在哈城等消息，在街上遇上賈金龍，以及開車來接賈金龍的姚玉玲，這才知道兩人的夫妻關係.(n)

programme.title: BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十五集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十五集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. 澔孫向眾人解釋，自己不是園長澔天，而是他的孫子澔孫，從60年後的未來世界回到現在。他在未來生活得不開心，所以爺爺澔天叫他回來找鐵盒，裡面會藏著答案。他來了 Bobieland 幾天，已經被大家快樂的氣氛吸引住，他終於都明白，開心其實很簡單。. 他決定返回60年後，臨走前叫眾人守秘密，怎料這時真正的澔天回來. . . . 【玩轉星期五】. 八位小朋友分成兩隊，小朋友首先要集齊指定科學家相關的關鍵詞，然後再去大電視區猜題目。究竟哪一隊可以贏取 BobieLand 大遊玩券呢.(n)

programme.title: 海鸚特攻隊
programme.desc: 托斯對奧斯的暴食行為感到不滿。迪迪和佩佩想辦法幫助他們和好如初.(n)

programme.title: 時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第七集：李臨落魄在快遞站搬運貨物
programme.desc: 忙碌一天的夢安來到快遞站看到穿着工作服搬運貨物的李臨，忍不住淚崩。許夢安打電話給梅一朵，說出了李臨失業的事。她希望梅一朵能幫李臨推薦一份合適的工作。婉真在自學銷售資料之餘，依然承擔着辦公室內勤雜活兒的工作.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 因為愛，才可以讓原本崎嶇不平的路得以行下去，讓彼此不孤單。. 63 歲的裝修師傅雞哥，與女友Sandy相知相交30年。然而，2022年的一個診斷改變了一切。雞哥被診斷患上了運動神經細胞疾病，並在短短 1 年內，情況已惡化至全身無法動彈、無法說話。一瞬間，Sandy 由被寵愛著的小女人變為照顧者，一力擔起照顧雞哥的責任，珍惜彼此二人餘下不多的時間。. 幸運的是，通過政府機構、屯門醫院紓緩科的團隊及社區團體-聖公會聖匠堂長者地區中心屬下安寧服務部的合作，Sandy和雞哥得到了屬於他們的專業支援，可以「活好」剩餘的時光，讓他們在照顧者的旅途上不再孤單，與照顧者同行以走更遠的路.(n)

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始
programme.desc: 第七集梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始. 〈跑者愛分享〉－梁雍婷. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與梁雍婷（Rachel）跑遍屯門海岸線。從海濱公園出發，經蝴蝶灣沙灘，終抵屯赤公園！伴隨著海水的氣息和無際的海景，Rachel分享跑步的純粹快樂：「對抗肌肉酸痛、找回呼吸節奏，喜歡挑戰自己的感覺！」海風伴著腳步，她笑著說：「跑步和演戲一樣，都要守住對事情的熱情！」能跑到老的答案很簡單，一起持續運動，腳步不停，熱情不熄！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－胸式呼吸 VS 腹式呼吸？. 跑步時總覺得呼吸急促、體力不足？你或許一直使用「胸式呼吸」，但你知道嗎，這種呼吸方式可能無法為肌肉提供足夠氧氣，讓你更容易感到疲累。「腹式呼吸」究竟有何神奇之處？如何透過簡單練習，提升跑步表現，讓呼吸更順暢、更輕鬆？. 〈一切從長跑開始〉. 長沙灣天主教英文中學最著名就是學校的長跑文化，創校初年已推行圍繞校園跑 25 圈的傳統，近年亦開始了中一生每天晨跑的習慣。長跑傳統如何孕育新一代，訓練出「自強不息」的特質？這是一個屬於長天長跑的故事.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：秦川為辦案在山上過年
programme.desc: 郭嘉琦建議通過懸賞發動群眾舉報炸藥來源。一名採石場的司機舉報，稱兩箱炸藥在爆炸案發生前被盜，但卻不知誰偷了炸藥，線索再次中斷。幹警們持續摸排，但毫無進展，秦川決定留在山上過年。年後，秦川下令擴大搜索範圍，終於找到了一個完整的遙控器，大家都歡呼雀躍.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 照顧者們
programme.desc: 因為愛，才可以讓原本崎嶇不平的路得以行下去，讓彼此不孤單。. 63 歲的裝修師傅雞哥，與女友Sandy相知相交30年。然而，2022年的一個診斷改變了一切。雞哥被診斷患上了運動神經細胞疾病，並在短短 1 年內，情況已惡化至全身無法動彈、無法說話。一瞬間，Sandy 由被寵愛著的小女人變為照顧者，一力擔起照顧雞哥的責任，珍惜彼此二人餘下不多的時間。. 幸運的是，通過政府機構、屯門醫院紓緩科的團隊及社區團體-聖公會聖匠堂長者地區中心屬下安寧服務部的合作，Sandy和雞哥得到了屬於他們的專業支援，可以「活好」剩餘的時光，讓他們在照顧者的旅途上不再孤單，與照顧者同行以走更遠的路.(n)

programme.title: 習近平經濟思想系列講讀
時光正好
programme.sub-title: 第七集：李臨落魄在快遞站搬運貨物
programme.desc: 忙碌一天的夢安來到快遞站看到穿着工作服搬運貨物的李臨，忍不住淚崩。許夢安打電話給梅一朵，說出了李臨失業的事。她希望梅一朵能幫李臨推薦一份合適的工作。婉真在自學銷售資料之餘，依然承擔着辦公室內勤雜活兒的工作.(n)

programme.title: 跑者愛也
programme.sub-title: 梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始
programme.desc: 第七集梁雍婷/一切從長跑開始. 〈跑者愛分享〉－梁雍婷. 主持梁諾妍（Inez）與梁雍婷（Rachel）跑遍屯門海岸線。從海濱公園出發，經蝴蝶灣沙灘，終抵屯赤公園！伴隨著海水的氣息和無際的海景，Rachel分享跑步的純粹快樂：「對抗肌肉酸痛、找回呼吸節奏，喜歡挑戰自己的感覺！」海風伴著腳步，她笑著說：「跑步和演戲一樣，都要守住對事情的熱情！」能跑到老的答案很簡單，一起持續運動，腳步不停，熱情不熄！. 〈跑者愛迷思〉－胸式呼吸 VS 腹式呼吸？. 跑步時總覺得呼吸急促、體力不足？你或許一直使用「胸式呼吸」，但你知道嗎，這種呼吸方式可能無法為肌肉提供足夠氧氣，讓你更容易感到疲累。「腹式呼吸」究竟有何神奇之處？如何透過簡單練習，提升跑步表現，讓呼吸更順暢、更輕鬆？. 〈一切從長跑開始〉. 長沙灣天主教英文中學最著名就是學校的長跑文化，創校初年已推行圍繞校園跑 25 圈的傳統，近年亦開始了中一生每天晨跑的習慣。長跑傳統如何孕育新一代，訓練出「自強不息」的特質？這是一個屬於長天長跑的故事.(n)

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: 由宋羅孟君女士（宋太）創辦的喜樂餐飲.教室，多年來為自閉症患者及有特殊需要人士提供工作及培訓機會，每天早上，宋太都會和患有自閉症及輕度智障的女兒Flora一同去「喜樂」開店，其後員工陸續到場，包括在「喜樂」工作多年的，患有中度智能障礙的「大師兄」陸永傑；與媽媽一同上班，雖然患有腦瘤但總是笑容滿面的張鎧晴，以及其他殘疾員工等。. 對宋太來說，這班員工不只是她的工作伙伴，更是情同家人。公司會定期為他們安排各種「課外活動」，員工的照顧者亦會被邀請同遊，令他們都得以享受親子樂。. 作為單親媽媽的宋太，當年因為女兒畢業後找不到工作的經歷，啟發到她為殘疾人士創辦可以安心工作的空間，助力他人的同時亦找到新的人生目標，希望「區區有喜樂」，用自己的每一分力量照亮弱勢社群的人生。. 這次「同行者」陳柏宇（Jason )會與「喜樂」一班員工一同解鎖「不可能的任務」，到底他們能否挑戰成功，令宋太與一眾照顧者有意外之喜.(n)

programme.title: 我是刑警
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集：秦川為辦案在山上過年
programme.desc: 郭嘉琦建議通過懸賞發動群眾舉報炸藥來源。一名採石場的司機舉報，稱兩箱炸藥在爆炸案發生前被盜，但卻不知誰偷了炸藥，線索再次中斷。幹警們持續摸排，但毫無進展，秦川決定留在山上過年。年後，秦川下令擴大搜索範圍，終於找到了一個完整的遙控器，大家都歡呼雀躍.(n)

programme.title: 習近平經濟思想系列講讀
BobieLand
programme.sub-title: 第九十五集 - 時光倒流60年
programme.desc: BobieLand 第九十五集-時光倒流60年. 編導:區達開. 澔孫向眾人解釋，自己不是園長澔天，而是他的孫子澔孫，從60年後的未來世界回到現在。他在未來生活得不開心，所以爺爺澔天叫他回來找鐵盒，裡面會藏著答案。他來了 Bobieland 幾天，已經被大家快樂的氣氛吸引住，他終於都明白，開心其實很簡單。. 他決定返回60年後，臨走前叫眾人守秘密，怎料這時真正的澔天回來. . . . 【玩轉星期五】. 八位小朋友分成兩隊，小朋友首先要集齊指定科學家相關的關鍵詞，然後再去大電視區猜題目。究竟哪一隊可以贏取 BobieLand 大遊玩券呢.(n)

programme.title: 動物童萌
programme.desc: 來認識最自主的動物寶寶，牠們在出生後不久就懂得如何行走、游泳或爬行，並會自行覓食。從剛出生就必須在沙灘上依靠導航爬向海洋的綠海龜寶寶，到看似平凡卻極其獨立、喜愛獨來獨往的家貓，我們會為你介紹地球上十大最自立、最堅韌、最令人驚嘆的動物寶寶.(n)

programme.desc: 海鸚們在奧圖的堡壘外打棒球時，一顆球擊中了改造過的天線，意外地在基地裏鑿開了一個黑洞.(n)

programme.desc: 托斯對奧斯的暴食行為感到不滿。迪迪和佩佩想辦法幫助他們和好如初.(n)

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 信訪局局長郝東風的親戚們找他辦事，讓他保醉駕的熟人，甚至讓他想辦法把郝家祖墳劃出遷墳的範圍內，郝東風不勝其煩。梅曉歌情真意切地感謝歷任村幹部一直以來的無私奉獻，並鞠躬懇請他們再次帶頭，動員村民們完成遷墳工作.(n)

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 梅曉歌在領導幹部大會上把不切實際的數字和目標抹掉，幹部們對此議論紛紛。呂青山收到了省環保督查組要來的消息，艾鮮枝發現養豬汙水污染河水的問題。市里答應給光明縣的資金因為環保問題暫緩了，呂青山只能重啟湖濱地產專案解決燃眉之急，但涉及一些幹部小院的拆遷.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 有一位才子，他有多重身分，既是填詞人、主持人、廣告人、作家、學者、台前和幕後等等. . . 他的招牌笑聲自帶一種才情和瀟灑。一首膾炙人口的《獅子山下》，是他的作品之一。今集我們談談香港流行文化的重要人物，一代詞人黃霑的創意一生。. 主持：. 米哈(作家). 黃仲遠(註冊組織心理學家). 朱耀偉(香港大學中文學院教授). 曾奕文(香港浸會大學音樂學院副教授). #黃霑#霑叔#學人沙龍#填詞#獅子山下.(n)

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
學人沙龍
programme.desc: 如果要說對香港有重大貢獻的建築師，何弢絕對是其中一位業界尊敬的建築師典範。由香港文化區到東區走廊板道，都有他的足跡；就連代表香港人的區旗區徽設計亦都有份參與其中，可見何弢對香港發展的貢獻，遠遠不止於建築。. 今集《學人沙龍》將會帶觀眾認識這位香港建築師何弢的作品和理念！. 主持：. 潘浩倫(建築師). 董正綱(建築師). 黎雋維(英國註冊建築師). 郭美珩(香港綠色建築議會董事). #學人沙龍#黎雋維#何弢#西九文化區#區旗#區徽.(n)

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.(n)

programme.title: 2026維也納愛樂新年音樂會
programme.sub-title: 2026維也納愛樂新年音樂會 (字幕版)
programme.desc: 2026年1月1日，享譽國際「維也納愛樂樂團」會在維也納金色大廳，演奏新年音樂會，並向世界轉播。維也納愛樂作為奧地利的音樂大使，藉此盛會向世界送上新年祝福，傳遞希望、友愛及和平的訊息。在1月17日下午，港台電視31經典重溫.(n)

programme.title: 《科學 ∙創未來3》
programme.sub-title: 第八集《與青少年交流對話》
programme.desc: 科學家的道路如何展開？他們在過程中面臨了哪些挑戰和困惑？這些經歷對於有志於科研的未來科學家來說，無疑是非常寶貴的。. 本屆的四位獲獎科學家——徐星教授、周忠和教授、戴希教授與丁洪教授，特別參與了為年輕人舉辦的「與年青人對話」的講座。他們與來自不同學校的香港中學生近距離交流，深入探討了從古生物學到前沿凝聚態物理學的話題，並分享了自己的成長之路，為整個大獎周活動畫上了完美的句號.(n)

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 設計的本意在於改善人類的生活. 梁雯蕙和李崇山兩人都是設計師，他們希望利用自己的專業來改善身體障礙者的生活。他們透過創新的產品及小發明，讓身體障礙者都能夠融入社會，有更好的生活體驗。 雖然香港鈔票有方便視障人士辨別鈔票面額的特徵，不過梁雯蕙觀察到，鈔票因為長期使用，特徵慢慢被磨損，點字特徵已近乎消失。梁雯蕙因而設計了一款直立皮革短夾，令視障人士閉眼一摸便可辨別鈔票面值。 李崇山一直關心弱勢社群，他設計的產品是與庇護工場合作生產。雖然庇護工場的殘疾人士在生產過程經常遇到困難，但他的工具幫助到殘疾人士更有效地完成生產。 還有一個社福機構的設計團隊度身訂造輔助工具,希望可以解決一些日常生活的情況, 他們都希望透過設計，提升殘疾人士的生活質素，因為設計本意應如此。今集主持Angel會親身去了解一下情況.(n)

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 曲阜、泰安
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 香港有約2200公里長的道路，登記車輛超過九十萬輛，道路使用率極高。為了提升城市道路的耐用度，讓行車更暢順，路政署和理工大學合作研發新的瀝青鋪路物料，並於今年四月開始，陸續在多條繁忙路段上使用。新物料在抗變形、抗老化及抗疲勞的表現均比舊物料優勝。除此以外，所有新建或重鋪的低噪音路面更同時全面改用低噪音新物料，降低輪胎和路面摩擦時產生的噪音約2.5分貝，相當於減少路面上接近一半車流量的噪音，令周邊環境更寧靜.(n)

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊霹靂舞隊不再限於街頭文化，而是直接打進奧運及全運舞台，並於剛過去的全運賽事中取得男子組總排名第五名的驕人成績。. 香港手球隊代表兼物理治療師葉冠英（大英）「捨手取腳」，憑著球場上的爆發力，迎接霹靂舞速度與智慧的考驗。大英跟教練學習搖滾步,排腿,定格等基本動作後即需接受比拼。他能否在短短1分鐘內編出自己的舞步，透過舞步展現自己的故事.(n)

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: Donovan為平息醜聞，赴達小姐的危險晚餐。他拒絕了誘惑與交易，堅守底線。另一邊，Pam協助他拍攝尋親影片，兩人感情迅速升溫，但Pam也因隱瞞的晚餐邀約而醋意大發。與此同時，外公發現Pam工作的真相，震怒下心臟病發，勒令她立即回家。Pam瞬間被推入事業、愛情與家庭責任的三難困境.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 香港有約2200公里長的道路，登記車輛超過九十萬輛，道路使用率極高。為了提升城市道路的耐用度，讓行車更暢順，路政署和理工大學合作研發新的瀝青鋪路物料，並於今年四月開始，陸續在多條繁忙路段上使用。新物料在抗變形、抗老化及抗疲勞的表現均比舊物料優勝。除此以外，所有新建或重鋪的低噪音路面更同時全面改用低噪音新物料，降低輪胎和路面摩擦時產生的噪音約2.5分貝，相當於減少路面上接近一半車流量的噪音，令周邊環境更寧靜.(n)

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 動聽的歌曲是百聽不厭的！《港樂．講樂》嚴選一系列值得回味的作品，讓大家再次可以欣賞歌手們的精彩表演。首先頭打陣的系列，就來一個活力爆燈的「動感快歌」。跳舞快歌講求力量與節奏感的配合，曲風、舞蹈編排都可以帶來不同的視聽享受。你的心水歌曲是否榜上有名？記得留意今集節目！. 主持. 阮頌陽.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: 「操肌」，曾經被視為係男士專屬的運動，追求的是肌肉及力量提升。不過近年越來越多女士、青少年，甚至殘疾人士都加入健身行列，希望改善體態，更視之為一種自信的生活方式。 全港連鎖健身中心數目在今年創歷史新高，這股風潮背後，反映了一種怎樣的生活態度？健身文化普及又對市民身心健康，以至社會經濟帶來甚麼影響.(n)

programme.title: 時光代理人

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊霹靂舞隊不再限於街頭文化，而是直接打進奧運及全運舞台，並於剛過去的全運賽事中取得男子組總排名第五名的驕人成績。. 香港手球隊代表兼物理治療師葉冠英（大英）「捨手取腳」，憑著球場上的爆發力，迎接霹靂舞速度與智慧的考驗。大英跟教練學習搖滾步,排腿,定格等基本動作後即需接受比拼。他能否在短短1分鐘內編出自己的舞步，透過舞步展現自己的故事.(n)

programme.title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團
programme.sub-title: 第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團山東篇 — 曲阜、泰安
programme.desc: 由外交部駐港公署、教育局，與明天更好基金聯合主辦「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽」已於五月份圓滿舉行。比賽過後，一眾優勝學生獲香港賽馬會特別贊助，參加內地參訪團，用腳步丈量神州大地的壯麗山河，用心來感受國家現代化建設的偉大成就，增加對國家的歸屬感和國民身份認同。. 參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的學生分別不同的中學。參訪團分別到訪北京、曲阜，泰安，潍坊，威海以及青島等地，亦會參觀景點，如故宫博物院、釣魚台、中國甲午戰爭博物館、總體國家安全觀主题展館等，更有機會旁聽外交部例行記者會並與青年外交官座談。. 節目會紀錄學生參加「第十七屆香港盃外交知識競賽參訪團」的全部過程，總結行程的所思所感，以體驗的形式學習、了解國情，以帶出學生將課本知識與考察內容有效地結合，對國家在科技、文化、經濟發展有更深一層認識.(n)

programme.title: 念
programme.desc: 器官捐贈微電影《念》，講述一位母親為離世兒子捐出器官時，所經歷嘅思念與抉擇，以及捐出兒子器官後，見證到受贈者與家屬重獲新生而萌生的全新體會。希望透過微電影鼓勵大眾踏出重要一步，支持器官捐贈，讓受贈者及他們的家人得到第二人生.(n)

programme.title: 我親愛的 Donovan
programme.desc: Donovan為平息醜聞，赴達小姐的危險晚餐。他拒絕了誘惑與交易，堅守底線。另一邊，Pam協助他拍攝尋親影片，兩人感情迅速升溫，但Pam也因隱瞞的晚餐邀約而醋意大發。與此同時，外公發現Pam工作的真相，震怒下心臟病發，勒令她立即回家。Pam瞬間被推入事業、愛情與家庭責任的三難困境.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 狗狗一樣要返工!. Cindy 的狗狗Happy是一隻小型貴婦狗，一年前應徵參加治療犬面試被成功取錄，一人一狗成為好拍檔，一心希望加入治療犬團隊，參與輔助治療，支援人類的身心靈健康。. 倪曉暉（Debbie）十多年前從事社工工作，主要接觸青少年，有一次因帶領青少年到狗場做義工，發現年輕人對著狗狗會變得包容有耐性。之後她成為認證動物輔助治療師，更帶著自己的狗狗珍珠，一同參與治療工作，藉著人狗互動，解開受情緒困擾或有特殊學習需要之兒童及青少年的心鎖。. 要成為治療犬，不但要通過面試、上課，更要實習、考試，一年以來，Cindy 和Happy積極準備，最後又能否成功呢.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 因為遇見你
programme.desc: 你有沒有翻山越嶺、跋山涉水、披星戴月，數十年如一日地做過一件事？今集我們將帶來幾個人類排除萬難、窮追不捨的故事。首先出場的是高原上行走的表情包藏狐，為了更多地了解牠們，研究者更通過專業手段為7隻藏狐佩戴了GPS頸圈.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 因為遇見你
programme.desc: 每種動物都有自己的領地和王國，但是有時候，牠們會和人類以特別的方式相遇，人類會面臨哪些問題？人類一直在幫動物們解決問題，包括行為問題、傷患問題、學習問題和成長問題。也許人類應該慶幸，對這些問題我們還有解決的能力，而且還有機會做得更好.(n)

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.sub-title: 鮮為人知的美味手亡豆

programme.desc: A)緋緋喜歡畫人臉—除了畫鼻子，她覺得畫鼻子好難。緋緋跟李太太和朋友去紅粉村藝術館參觀鼻子藝術展覽，還上了著名鼻子藝術家羅泰娜夫人的一節特別課堂.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 透過與拿騷年輕創作人的交往，我們看到這個巴哈馬首都的另一面；這些「天堂鳥」把加勒比海島國的娛樂事業，推進到另一個新紀元。原來，在拿騷只要踏出慣常的遊客熱點，就可以看見巴哈馬人比起環島海洋更耀眼的光芒。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月22日 星期二晚，10時30分 Along with the young Creatives of Nassau we get to experience a side of Nassau that has never been seen before. These ‘Birds of Paradise’ push the creative edge of the Caribbean islands to a new era of entertainment. We come to learn that should one step off the tourist grid in Nassau, the Bahamian people are more vibrant than the very oceans that surround these islands. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.22 TUE 10:30pm.(n)

programme.title: 31看世界 - 音樂旅人
programme.desc: 埃克蘇馬群島完全能夠展現出加勒比海天堂這個美譽，區內三百六十五個島嶼，充滿著各式各樣神話傳說，更添加上一份傳奇色彩。我們來到探索水底藍洞，品嚐新鮮海螺沙律、烤石班、烤龍蝦和烤蟹，隨著傳說故事，探索海天一色的夢幻埃克蘇馬。 雙語廣播： 粵語/英語 (電視版 及 網上版) 播出時間： (首播) 2025年4月22日 星期二晚，11時00分 The islands of Exuma are the picture perfect description of a Caribbean paradise. Stories, myths and legends fuse with everyday life across the 365 islands within the Exumas. We come to learn that the treasure is scattered in the beauty of the Exumas, from the natural Blue Holes, to the fresh conch salad, the roasted Grouper to the Lobster and crabs. We follow the Legends to discover that the land and ocean blend perfectly into the story of the Exumas. Bilingual: Cantonese/ English (TV Version & Web Version) Time: (First run) 2025.4.22 TUE 11:00pm.(n)

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.sub-title: Televised dining of the golden age
programme.desc: Hong Kong’s television industry was once thriving, the 1970s and 1980s are fondly remembered as the “TV boom” era, a shared memory among Hong Kong residents. In recent years, however, the rise of streaming platforms and intensified competition from neighboring regions have led to a decline in advertising revenue for commercially operated broadcasters, posing a significant challenge to the local TV sector. How can television professionals stay competitive and collectively promote “Hong Kong productions” into broader markets, restoring the industry’s former glory.(n)

programme.title: 政正關你事
programme.desc: 香港有約2200公里長的道路，登記車輛超過九十萬輛，道路使用率極高。為了提升城市道路的耐用度，讓行車更暢順，路政署和理工大學合作研發新的瀝青鋪路物料，並於今年四月開始，陸續在多條繁忙路段上使用。新物料在抗變形、抗老化及抗疲勞的表現均比舊物料優勝。除此以外，所有新建或重鋪的低噪音路面更同時全面改用低噪音新物料，降低輪胎和路面摩擦時產生的噪音約2.5分貝，相當於減少路面上接近一半車流量的噪音，令周邊環境更寧靜.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.desc: Indians are in fact the fourth largest ethnic minority group in Hong Kong after Filipinos, Indonesians and Whites. India and Hong Kong are connected because both places were ruled by Britain from the mid 19th century. Indians sold fabric and clothes made in Hong Kong to British people. They also set up trading companies and exported goods to other Commonwealth countries, to take a share in the huge trade market. . Bilingual: English / Cantonese (TV Version) Time: (First run) 2024.05.13 MON 10:30pm / RTHK32.(n)

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 呂青山即將卸任光明縣委書記，梅曉歌接任。周良順書記是較早建房的幹部代表，喬勝利去周良順家勸說，周良順拿出前光明縣書記下發的房屋合法的手續，喬勝利無功而返。為瞭解財政的燃眉之急，梅曉歌去九原縣找曹立新借錢，商定好從光明縣醫院的現金儲存按月按比例還錢.(n)

programme.title: 縣委大院
programme.desc: 呂青山把擔子交給梅曉歌，處理好相關事務，低調地離開了縣委大院。交警亂罰款扣車損害了光明縣的形象，梅曉歌下令整改。梅曉歌到長嶺村跟眾人了解廠房關停後村民們的工作生活情況；又駛過顛簸的路段到奶牛基地走訪，了解修路太久的問題.(n)

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 本集將探索人與動物關係的演變。從古代中國及世界文明談起，我們回溯動物曾作為勞動力、祭祀神靈的媒介，甚至是賭博與馬戲團中的娛樂工具，隨著時代推移，這種功利關係逐漸轉化為情感依託。我們將剖析「寵物」概念的興起，看昔日文人雅士賞玩的花鳥蟲魚，如何演變為今日家中備受呵護的貓狗以至動物權益的誕生。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 陳家怡(嶺南大學歷史系研究助理教授).(n)

證義搜查線之騙局拼圖 (普通話)
programme.desc: 上市医美公司「正在美丽」老板蒋慧敏，以配新股方法筹集资金来购买声称潜力甚高的「安然制药」，但证监会怀疑后者只是业务不明的空壳公司。调查员凯茵独自进行厂房实地查核时遇上小意外受伤，上司Tony却重申不同意她过份拚搏的思维，并揭示自己的调查：蒋慧敏向「安然」负责人麦江出价购买公司是为藉词配股，此前她已操控「人头户口」来推高股价，制造利好假象，惟户口全不在境内，令举证困难。坚执的凯茵咬住不放，在渺茫希望下仍翻查大量资料，终找到破洞，成功证明蒋慧敏直接导致市场失当的行为，令本来趾高气扬的她无话可说！其实Tony与凯茵各因其人生经历而有既成的价值观──凯茵曾有一位挚友被骗财骗色后，一时想不开而寻短，令凯茵对骗徒极度咬牙切齿；而Tony则历过千帆，明悟凡事有因有果，不必过于执着。两人的分歧在调查工作上，渐趋明显，如何能成功磨合.(n)

programme.title: 香港故事 - 尾巴會說話
programme.desc: 每隻鸚鵡都是性格巨星，「望咩呀？望望望！」是非洲灰鸚鵡「芭芭雞」的招牌金句。牠是模仿說話的高手，也是家中的破壞之王。故事始於Yoyo十六歲那年，家中迎來了這位新成員，全家人都很雀躍，唯獨是Yoyo覺得家裡多了一個不速之客。九年的相處，讓Yoyo從最初的畏懼，逐漸被灰鸚鵡的智慧和淘氣融化。牠的日常金句和生活片段，更成為Yoyo設計路上的創作靈感和追夢的動力。. 至於珊珊則喜歡小巧可愛的愛情鳥，牠們溫柔的鳴叫聲，以及宛如水彩畫般層層暈染的羽毛色彩，深深觸動了她。2023年的某一天，珊珊發現其中一對愛情鳥悄然發展成為戀人，開始築巢生蛋。新生命的誕生，為珊珊帶來了難以言喻的感動與喜悅。. 無論鸚鵡的性格如何，Yoyo與珊珊都珍惜與牠們相處的每一個小日子，當中有笑有淚，也滿載無法計量的愛與陪伴.(n)

programme.title: 醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康 II
programme.desc: 今集的主題食材外表平平無奇，狀似枯木，卻擁有「神仙之食」的美譽——它就是淮山！大廚 Will 發揮無限創意，炮製出色香味俱全的「淮山茶碗蒸」，令兩位嘉賓吃出驚喜。. 身兼長跑教練與星級媽媽的梁諾妍（Inez）活力充沛，熱愛「朝活」的她有時會睡眠不足，但是原來長期熬夜或睡眠質素欠佳，竟是引發脂肪肝的隱形元兇！今集我們邀請到黃麗虹教授深入探討護肝之道，拆解「168斷食法」配合運動如何有效逆轉脂肪肝，並剖析市面上護肝產品成效。兩位成功女性更大方分享如何平衡事業與家庭，以及堅持運動的心得。此外，「識食專員」走入農莊，親身體驗挖淮山的難度。. 主持：黃婉曼（Icy）、Will Leung. 嘉賓：梁諾妍（ Inez）、黃麗虹醫生（香港中文大學醫學院內科及藥物治療學系教授/. 腸胃肝臟科專科.(n)
